newsitem.title: USA: Big trade gap could mean slightly lower Dow open.
newsitem.headline: Big trade gap could mean slightly lower Dow open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open slightly lower on Wednesday after the July trade deficit widened significantly, to $11.68 billion.
It was the widest deficit since the monthly average in the fourth quarter of 1987 and surprised economists who had expected an $8.8 billion deficit.

"The trade deficit number is going to add to the market's softness today. But this isn't the key number, it's the combination of the number plus the fear of higher interest rates," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock and Co.
